scope: Independent engineering review of the Value Theory renderer, discovery refresh, Python safeguards, browser test and local preview server. Not an independent French semantic certification.

findings.detail: Unrestricted --preview-dir could equal the repository and write unreviewed public pages outside write_outputs guards. Safely reproduced with mocked writes. Added resolved directory exclusion and per-output containment checks, including nested symlink escape rejection before writes.
Manuscript index title was used by discovery but not rendered. Added escaped heading, document title and social-title updates with idempotence test.
Receipt verification alone did not establish that public HTML matched reviewed inputs. Discovery now requires all 54 render outputs to match disk before building updates.
Module import now raises RuntimeError if __debug__ is false, protecting direct helper imports and all dependent entrypoints. Subprocess regressions cover explicit -O and PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1.
Dedicated table checks now iterate all eight languages, including Spanish and Traditional Chinese. Syntax verified; runtime browser acceptance remains pending.

verification.preflight_result: 15 tests passed, including -O and PYTHONOPTIMIZE subprocess failure cases
verification.static_checks: Python AST parsing passed for all four Python files; node --check passed after eight-language table expansion. No remaining static blocker identified. Optimized Python explicitly rejected at module load.
verification.source_preservation: Chinese and Traditional Chinese preservation and recognized English baseline/correction checks passed. No public HTML or other translators’ files changed by this worker.
verification.release_tests: Not executed: complete independent receipts and final public rendering are parent-controlled and still pending.
verification.browser_tests: Not executed by this reviewer. Parent browser acceptance remains pending; script syntax only checked.

remaining_caveats.detail: All output hashes are prechecked, but 54 writes are not transactional. An I/O interruption may leave a partial batch. Full render/check and rerun hash guards provide recovery verification; complete those checks before publishing. No transaction architecture added.

parent_followup: Parent independently reviewed the first three fixes and reran the prior 14 tests successfully. Review the optimized-mode and eight-language additions, then complete release and browser acceptance. This report does not mark publication ready.
